title: OperationalEvent
description: A single operational or financial event. For type=check, amount is a positive outflow (not a signed ledger debit). For type=summary, amount is an aggregate total — do not add summary rows to check-line totals. Consumers that need signed accounting amounts must convert explicitly.

type.description: Event kind. summary rows are aggregates; check/deposit/transfer are line items.

date.description: Event date as YYYY-MM-DD (pattern-enforced; format annotation alone is not enough for all validators).

amount.description: USD amount. check/deposit/transfer: positive means outflow on council check listings. summary: aggregate total for the described rollup — never sum with sibling line items.

description.description: Short human-readable description (payee + memo or summary label).

metadata.description: Extensible bag. check rows should include enterpriseId, checkNumber, payee when available. summary rows should include byEnterprise and/or grandTotal.

schemaVersion.description: Optional human-readable contract version for this payload.
